baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun ثِيَابَكَ is the direct object of the intensive imperative فَطَهِّرْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garment branch supplies an actual covering, while the purification branches specify removal of defilement and enacted washing; together they make this an active cleansing command rather than a general preference for neatness.

activation_trace.role: Clothing and covering supply the literal possessed object on which the command operates.
Purity through removal of defilement makes the operation subtractive and result-oriented.
Enacted washing with water keeps a concrete laundering or ritual-cleaning route live.

changed_reading.before: A generic instruction to appear clean.
changed_reading.after: Act on the actual garments or covering so that defilement is removed and a purified state is produced.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventory explicitly lets ثِيَاب denote clothing and serve as an image for the self, while طَهِّرْ can cleanse self and conduct from blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus branches overlap at the garment-self idiom: the outer covering can index the wearer, and purification can target character and action without dissolving the lexical garment anchor.

activation_trace.role: The branch includes both garments and source-attested garment imagery for the self, joining outer covering to wearer.
Cleansing self, heart, deed, and conduct from blame turns the garment image into an ethical operation.

changed_reading.after: Purify the wearer’s character and conduct as what the possessed garment visibly carries and signifies.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثِيَابَكَ remains the explicit garment, but its root inventory also contains recompense returning to the doer; طَهِّرْ can target deed and conduct.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garment is provisionally read as an envelope of action that stays with its wearer, while the return branch of ث و ب opens a second temporal axis: what is done can come back as recompense and therefore calls for purification before return.

activation_trace.role: Recompense returning from an act to its doer supplies the return path provisionally folded into the garment root.
The actual garment and self-as-garment image keep the return reading attached to the focus noun.
Purifying deed and conduct supplies the kind of material that can later return as recompense.

changed_reading.before: The garment only represents present appearance or character.
changed_reading.after: Purify the action-envelope now because what it carries may return to its doer as recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening address supplies both an over-garment and a film of grime or rust caused by neglected polishing. Read against the focus garment and removal imperative, purification becomes emergence from accumulated covering: the layer that enclosed the addressee must no longer carry the residue of enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The garment and self-as-garment branch supplies the focus layer whose condition is changed.
Removal of defilement supplies the cleansing operation applied to accumulated covering.
An outer wrap worn over an inner layer makes the address a concrete image of enclosure and layering.
A grime or rust film formed through neglected polishing supplies the accreted residue that purification removes.

structural_cues: 74:1 names the addressee by a wrapping state; 74:2 orders rising, and 74:4 then orders purification of the possessed garment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered wrapping and a neglected surface-film; I infer that the command sequence moves from enclosure to removal of accumulated impediment. A live alternative is ordinary garment cleanliness before public warning.

changed_reading.before: Clean a garment as an isolated hygiene task.
changed_reading.after: Shed the residue of prolonged enclosure from the garment-self as part of rising into the commanded task.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following command pairs destabilizing agitation with decisive separation. This turns purification from repeated surface treatment into boundary maintenance: a clean garment-self is kept clean by breaking contact with what continually reintroduces disorder.

activation_trace.role: Garment and self-as-garment supply the boundary on which contamination or integrity becomes visible.
Cleansing conduct from blame supplies the ethical state that must be preserved.
Agitation and successive unstable motion supply the contaminating disorder against which purity is maintained.
Cutting off and parting supply separation as the practical means of preventing renewed contamination.

structural_cues: 74:4 and 74:5 are adjacent coordinated imperatives: purify the garments, then abandon the rujz.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agitation followed by severance; I infer that separation functions as a maintenance condition for purity. The live alternative is that 74:5 names a wholly separate obligation rather than a causal method.

changed_reading.before: Purity is achieved by cleaning after a stain appears.
changed_reading.after: Purity also requires severing the relation that repeatedly deposits disorder on the garment-self.

context_deltas.mechanism: A human completeness branch explicitly joins outward and inward, while the heart is the core and its disease can darken and reduce clarity. These cues sharpen the garment-self baseline into an integrity model: purification is not cosmetic treatment of an outer sign but restoration of agreement between visible conduct and the inner core.

activation_trace.role: The garment and self-as-garment branch supplies the visible outer index of the wearer.
Purification of self, heart, deed, and conduct allows the focus operation to reach beneath appearance.
Human completeness joining outward and inward supplies the criterion of integrity rather than polished surface alone.
The pure core or kernel supplies the inner locus with which the outer garment-sign must agree.
Disease as darkening and loss of clarity supplies an inward form of soil that external laundering cannot cure.

structural_cues: Within 74:31, disease is located in hearts and the long ayah closes by identifying the warning as a reminder for humankind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outward-inward completeness image, an inner core, and diminished clarity; I infer that the possessed garment acts as a diagnostic interface between core and conduct. A live alternative keeps heart disease and garment purification as independent images.

changed_reading.before: A clean exterior can stand as sufficient evidence of purity.
changed_reading.after: Purify until the visible garment of conduct truthfully agrees with an undarkened inner core.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context identifies the self itself, what it acquires, and its being held as security for a claim. This activates the focus root’s returning-recompense branch: deeds are acquired layers that adhere like a garment, return to the doer, and can hold the self liable unless purified.

activation_trace.role: Recompense returning to the doer supplies the temporal return of what the garment-self carries.
Purification of deed and conduct supplies the intervention before acquired action returns as liability.
The thing’s very self or identity makes the wearer, not merely the clothing, the accountable subject.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies acquisition as the process by which deeds become attached holdings.
A document or pledge held against a right supplies the binding legal force of what has been acquired.

structural_cues: 74:38 places self, acquisition, and pledged liability in one compact predication: every self is held by what it earned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identity, acquisition, collateral, and a focus branch of returning recompense; I infer that acquired deeds adhere like a garment and return as a claim on the wearer. The live alternative is general accountability with no garment metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Purify present character because clean conduct is intrinsically fitting.
changed_reading.after: Purify what your actions add to the self before those acquisitions return and bind the wearer as liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later confession names omitted worship and omitted feeding in parallel. That pair operationalizes clean conduct: the purified garment-self is tested both in directed ritual practice and in material provision to another person, preventing an inward-only or appearance-only reading.

activation_trace.role: The self-as-garment image supplies conduct as the visible clothing of the accountable wearer.
Cleansing deed and conduct from blame supplies the baseline that the later omissions make concrete.
The specified act of worship supplies a ritual enactment by which purified conduct is embodied.
Feeding another supplies a material and social enactment of clean conduct beyond private devotion.

structural_cues: 74:43-44 gives two parallel first-person plural omissions: not being among those who pray and not feeding the poor person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired failures of worship and feeding; I infer that they exemplify the conduct meant to clothe the self cleanly. A live alternative treats the list as consequences unrelated to the earlier garment command.

changed_reading.before: Purification is private cleanliness or an inward moral state.
changed_reading.after: Purified garments are worn as enacted conduct, joining worship toward God with material care toward another person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial root contains the unusually exact image of a garment that lies by its condition. It supplies a negative foil to the focus: purification removes the mismatch by which an outward covering presents a state that the wearer’s actual allegiance or conduct contradicts.

activation_trace.role: The garment and self-as-garment branch supplies the outward state capable of representing its wearer.
Purifying self and conduct supplies the correction that makes outward presentation agree with actual practice.
A garment that lies by its condition supplies the exact deceptive-surface model that the focus command reverses.

structural_cues: 74:46 places denial at the end of the retrospective confession in 74:43-46, after failures of worship, feeding, and discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial and a branch image of a deceptive garment; I infer that purification means removing representational falsehood between surface and wearer. The live alternative is that the rare garment image is only a lexical curiosity with no role here.

changed_reading.before: A clean garment improves the wearer’s appearance.
changed_reading.after: Purify the garment so that the state it displays no longer lies about the wearer’s actual conduct and commitments.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing roots pair placing the self in protection with a covering that shields the sinner from a deed’s effect. They revise purification as more than stripping stain or cover away: the cleansed garment-self is re-covered protectively, distinguishing concealment that deceives from covering that preserves.

activation_trace.role: Garment and self-as-garment supply a covering that can protect as well as display.
Removal of defilement supplies the first movement of repair before protective covering is restored.
Placing the self within protection supplies a preserved state rather than bare exposure after cleansing.
Covering a sin while shielding its bearer from its effect supplies protective, non-deceptive re-covering.

structural_cues: 74:56 closes the surah by pairing worthiness of taqwa with worthiness of forgiveness after the repeated reminder sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-protection and sin-covering; I infer a complementary sequence of stain removal followed by protective re-covering. A live alternative leaves these closing attributes independent of the garment command.

changed_reading.before: Purification works only by removing every covering and exposing what lies beneath.
changed_reading.after: Remove the defiling layer, then understand the clean garment as protective covering that preserves rather than deceives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ثِيَابَ directly names garments, not an act of calling; it remains root-anchored through the focus inventory’s repeated-call branch and is activated by warning and recurrent reminder language. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary root resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier stays attached to the ث و ب root at focus word 1 and subjects that root-resonance to the explicit purification imperative at word 2.

activation_trace.role: A repeated or returning call supplies the branch-distant vocal resonance latent in the focus garment root.
Removal of defilement supplies a demand that the recurrent call itself be cleared of distortion.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the public call whose delivery can carry the root resonance.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies recurrence of the communicative act across the surah.

changed_reading.before: Purification concerns only the garment or the conduct it symbolizes.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, purify the warning each time it returns so the repeated call carries no added distortion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation: water immersion normally supports washing, while خوض also names entering discourse. It remains valid as an analogy because the focus explicitly joins garments with enacted washing and the context joins water-entry and discourse-entry in one root inventory; downstream prose should mark it as a cautionary mechanism, not lexical identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus garment at word 1 is acted on by a purification root whose inventory includes washing with water at word 2.

activation_trace.role: The actual garment and self-as-garment image supply the surface that immersion may clean or soil.
Ritual washing with water supplies the expected cleansing form of entering a liquid medium.
Entering water supplies the physical immersion that initially resembles the focus washing mechanism.
Entering speech or an affair reverses the image by making collective discourse a medium that can soil rather than cleanse.

changed_reading.before: Immersion in a shared medium is naturally cleansing.
changed_reading.after: Not every immersion purifies: entering corrupt discourse can stain the garment-self even while water-entry evokes washing.

strongest_changes: The opening wrapped state turned laundering into removal of an accumulated layer before rising into the task.
The self-acquisition-pledge sequence made the ث و ب return branch temporal and juridical: acquired deeds return and bind their wearer.
The denial inventory’s garment that lies by its condition made truthful agreement between surface and wearer a distinct purification model.
The closing protection and forgiveness roots distinguished deceptive covering from protective re-covering after defilement is removed.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly activated the difference between kinds of covering: a wrap that encloses, grime that accretes, a garment that can misrepresent, conduct that clothes the self, and forgiveness that covers protectively. The exact lying-garment branch was the sharpest surprise, while returning recompense connected the garment root to later earned liability.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not force a choice between literal garment care and the explicit self-and-conduct idiom; both remain live.
The recompense and repeated-call branches are root-distant from the plural noun ثِيَاب and should remain secondary resonances.
Treating separation from rujz as a method of maintaining purity and protective covering as a second repair phase depends on reader-supplied causal arrows.
